paragraphs.text: Codex-style side chat for DeepSeek Harness: a temporary read-only branch of the current session in t
he right sidebar, destroyed when closed.
# Live Side Chat (`dsh-live-side-chat`)
> 中文 | English
A **Codex-style side chat** for DeepSeek Harness: open a temporary **empty** conversation in the rig
ht sidebar that follows the current session's work live, ask "how is it going?" or "confirm that con
clusion" while the main session keeps working, and destroy it by closing the tab.
It is **not** a fork. It never copies the main session's history; it runs empty and reads a live dig
* a fork. It never copies the main session's history; it runs empty and reads a live digest instead:
- **Empty start** — the child session is created with no `seed` and no `isSeeded`, so the tab opens
as a genuinely empty conversation. It can be created at any time; it no longer waits for the main se

ssion to complete a turn.
- **Live digest, not a log copy** — the side chat learns about the main se
ssion from the plugin's own bounded `sideChatDigest` session projection, re-read as runtime context
on every step. Work that happened *after* the side chat was created is visible; the digest is partia

l by design, so the model verifies details with the read-only tools before asserting them.
[该节后续省略]
## Features
| Capability | Description |

| Sidebar entry | Adds a "Side chat" box to the right sidebar's guide page |
| `/btw` | Opens the si

de chat from the composer |
| Empty start | The child session opens with no inherited history, so th

e tab is a real empty conversation |
| Live digest | `sideChatDigest` projection: goal, one line per

settled turn, the open turn, todos, recent tools, counters — bounded and clipped |
| Live context |

Re-read and injected as runtime context on every step, so work after creation is visible |
| Status
strip | Main-session title, running/idle dot, turn number, todo progress, newest tool, relative act

ivity, open-turn prompt |
| Background digest | Collapsed panel in the strip; expands the exact bloc

k the model reads (same renderer as the injection) |
| Empty greeting | Plugin-owned card naming the

connected main session, plus three quick questions |
| Composer | Anchored at the bottom of the pan
el and reusing the main conversation composer chrome: the same elevated rounded card, a read-only pi

ll and a 34px circular send button |
| Model chip | Shows the model the next turn will use and opens
a picker over every model the Host can route (grouped by provider); the switch applies from the nex

t turn only, and the main session is never touched |
| Read-only tools | `side_chat_main_status` (fr
eshest digest + running/idle) and `side_chat_main_history` (`turn` / `contains` filters, bounded, re

al log lines) |
| Report back | `side_chat_report` queues a result into the main session; can be dis

abled in settings |
| Close confirmation | "Close this side chat?" dialog with "Don't ask again"; ca

ncel reopens the tab |
| Destruction | Disposes the agent and removes the session's JSONL directory;
success is verified through the persistence seam |
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **One fold, three consumers** — the digest is a regular `sideChatDigest` session projection (`src/
digest.ts`): the framework folds it incrementally on every committed event, the projection cache per
sists it, and the Host-wide control stream pushes it to the browser, so the model, the status strip

and restart recovery read the same state.
- **Bounded by construction** — per session it keeps the f
irst human prompt (`goal`), recent settled turns (prompt, final reply, tool count, error count; `dig
estTurns`, 4–60), the open turn (prompt, steps, latest assistant text, recent tool calls, error coun
t, start time), the latest whole todo list, recent tool calls, the last error, monotonic counters an

d `lastActivityAt`. Every string is clipped and every array is capped.
- **Injected as live context*
* — the side chat registers `systemPrompt.context({ name: 'side-chat:main-digest', order: 220, text:
() => ... })`, which re-reads the main session's digest synchronously on every step and renders it
as a "Main session live digest (partial; verify any detail with the side_chat_main_history or side_c
hat_main_status tool before asserting it)" block. Work that happened after the side chat was created

is visible; a fork could never show that.
- **Prompt discipline** — the `side-chat:role` prompt sec
tion states that the digest is partial and is not the log, and that the model must call the read-onl

y tools before asserting that work is done, that a file changed, or that an error was fixed.
- **Hos
t half** (`src/`) creates the hidden child with `ctx.agents.create(...)`, passing no `seed` and no `
isSeeded`, so its conversation opens empty. Its `setup` mounts the main session's preset, registers
the role prompt, the digest context, the three tools and the read-only guard, and appends `sandbox/m

ode`, `approval/policy` and `subagent/descriptor`.
- The `subagent/descriptor` is required: the Web
client refuses ordinary history reads for an `origin: 'subagent'` session, and only a descriptor-bac

ked child can use the `subagent` history route.
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
- A crashed or force-quit Host can leave an already-destroyed-pending side-chat session on disk: not
hing sweeps hidden `session-side-chat-*` directories at startup, so a stale one stays until it is re

moved manually.
- Confirmation happens **after** the close: the right sidebar exposes no close veto,
so the dialog appears when the tab is already gone, and "Cancel" reopens the tab (brief close/reope

n flash).
- The digest is a bounded summary, not the log: strings are clipped, arrays are capped, ea
rlier turns are one line each, and it omits tool results, file contents and most intermediate steps.

Details must come from the read-only tools.
- Destruction depends on the JSONL session layout (`$DS
H_HOME/sessions/<projectKey>/<sessionId>/`). With another persistence backend or a custom root, set
`sessionsRoot`; every removal is verified with `sessionPersistence.stat()` and a failure is reported

honestly in the dialog.
- Borrowing the subagent descriptor is an unsupported-but-stable interactio
n: a descriptor version bump upstream must be mirrored here. Baseline: dsh `0.2.1-rc.2` (commit `687

f282e`).
- `sandbox/mode: read-only` guarantees writes fail; `bash` may still run read-only commands

.
- The plugin requires `webServer` and `connection`, so it targets the Web/desktop deployments; a h
eadless profile without a web server leaves the Host half inactive.
